description: Defines coaching personas that nutritionists and fitness coaches can adopt, each with distinct focus areas, dimension weightings, and recommendation thresholds for guiding clients toward healthier, easier meals.

nutritionist.label: Nutritionist
nutritionist.description: Focuses on dietary quality, micronutrient intake, and long-term health outcomes. Recommends recipes that balance health with approachable complexity.

beginner.label: Nutrition Newcomer
beginner.description: Client new to mindful eating. Needs simple recipes with obvious health benefits.

intermediate.label: Health-Conscious Cook
intermediate.description: Client comfortable with basic cooking. Ready to explore nutrient-dense ingredients.

advanced.label: Nutrition Enthusiast
advanced.description: Experienced cook who wants to optimize macro and micronutrient profiles.

fitness_coach.label: Fitness Coach
fitness_coach.description: Focuses on meal timing, protein intake, and energy availability for training. Recommends recipes that fuel performance while remaining practical for busy athletes.

beginner.label: Casual Exerciser
beginner.description: Exercises 2-3 times per week. Needs straightforward meals that support basic activity.

intermediate.label: Regular Athlete
intermediate.description: Trains 4-5 times per week. Needs reliable meal prep that supports recovery.

advanced.label: Competitive Athlete
advanced.description: Intense training schedule. Needs precise macros and meal timing around workouts.

meal_prep_coach.label: Meal Prep Coach
meal_prep_coach.description: Specializes in batch cooking efficiency. Recommends recipes that scale well, store well, and minimize kitchen time across the week.

beginner.label: Prep Starter
beginner.description: New to batch cooking. Needs recipes that are forgiving and make good leftovers.

intermediate.label: Weekly Prepper
intermediate.description: Preps meals once or twice a week. Comfortable managing multiple recipes simultaneously.

advanced.label: Bulk Prepper
advanced.description: Prepares large batches for freezing and long-term storage. Values scalability above all.

wellness_coach.label: Wellness Coach
wellness_coach.description: Holistic approach combining nutrition with stress reduction and mindful eating. Recommends recipes that nourish without overwhelming, favoring low-complexity, high-satisfaction meals.

beginner.label: Stress-Free Starter
beginner.description: Overwhelmed client who needs the simplest path to better eating.

intermediate.label: Mindful Eater
intermediate.description: Building a sustainable routine. Values calm, enjoyable cooking experiences.

advanced.label: Holistic Practitioner
advanced.description: Deeply committed to wellness lifestyle. Explores therapeutic ingredients and techniques.
